text: Cardinal Point and Value: Ger. Kardinalpunkt u. -werth ; Fr. valeur ( et point ) cardinale ; Ital. valore (and punto ) cardinale . Introduced by Fechner for the point and the stimulus-value (Reizwert) of the 'relative maximum of sensation' (Fechner, Elemente d. Psychophysik , ii. 49). Cardinal value is defined by Külpe ( Outlines of Psychol ., Eng. trans., 250) as 'the value at which sensation increases in direct proportion to stimulus intensity.' See FECHNER'S LAW, and WEBER'S LAW. ( J.M.B. )
